note: Transcription of the manufacturer datasheets of the SOT-23 two-line TVS arrays in the B1 snapshot (jlc_catalog/2026-10-30), fetched 2026-11-23 through each snapshot page's LCSC datasheet link and read from the rendered pin diagram and internal circuit. Every part puts its two protected lines on pins 1 and 2 and its common terminal on pin 3. The PDFs are not committed, their SHA-256 is. Left out: SM712 (C7420375, Hongjiacheng), whose sheet draws the 7 V and 12 V directions opposite to ProTek's PSM712 and whose table headers read either way.

parts.circuit: per line two avalanche diodes in series, anodes joined internally: 12 V diode cathode on IO (pin1/pin2), 7 V diode cathode on pin3. Asymmetric: IO positive vs pin3 -> 12 V; pin3 positive -> 7 V (Note 1)

ratings.IPP: 30 A (12 V dir) / 34 A (7 V dir), 8/20us

datasheet.pinout: p1 'PIN CONFIGURATION'; p2 'Electrical Characteristics per line' + Note 1; p4 'Figure 1 Spice Model' (labels 12/7 diodes)

parts.notes: Package outline page note 'Pin 3 is the cathode (Unidirectional Only)' is a generic package note, not applicable. Polarity is the OPPOSITE of the Hongjiacheng SM712 (C7420375) datasheet.
